config.note: Case regions are read from experiments.json (same selections as P0-A/P0-B). guitar_dist is a synthetic derived source (see p0/split_experiment.py).

notes: Every render is RMS-matched to target_rms_dbfs over level_window_s BEFORE the MEMORY envelope; match_gain_db is recorded per render. FULL renders use crossovers_full; FILTERED renders use crossovers_filtered resolved inside the selected band, so FULL vs FILTERED differ in source AND crossover placement. WAVs are not committed.
